limitations: Recorded development outcomes only; no model calls, plan recompilation or current-checker regrading.
Criterion denominators are credited returned plans. Compilation failures have separate observed compile/task denominators; codes overlap.
Logged schema errors and compile checks are observed counts, not proof that omitted actions were valid. A provider-call/event count gap does not identify omitted action types or causes.
Engine validity is conditional on supplied synthetic geometry and is not physical safety or brief preservation.
A valid intermediate compile is not a graded final plan and receives no productive credit. Raw library fallback plans do not receive model-success credit.
Witness absence is unresolved, not proof of infeasibility. Twelve scene groups contain dependent movement tasks.
This attempt is separate from the initial GPT network pilot, failed warmups, other arms, and future confirmation.
Diagnosis does not establish creator benefit or authorize tuning the frozen candidate.
